title: Formation of the Shard of Twelve Worlds

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: An envelope containing twelve planes, separating them from the rest of the Multiverse; formed as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Formation of the Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A silent but important event in the later Dark Age on Terisiare.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Blast that bound nearby planes together and created a barrier to travel.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane confirmed within the Shard.

entities.name: Azoria
entities.description: A plane confirmed within the Shard.

entities.name: Ravidel's home plane
entities.description: Ravidel's unnamed home plane, within the Shard.

entities.name: Nether Void
entities.description: A pocket dimension accessible within the Shard.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane outside the Shard, cut off from Dominaria.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane that drifts through the Multiverse and could pass the Shard's boundary.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Later gathering held with Shandalar's effect in mind.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast binds several nearby planes together as the Dominarian Nexus and forms a barrier to travel in or out, creating the Shard.
events.quote: The Shard was formed as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast .

events.summary: Many planeswalkers are trapped inside or locked out of the Shard during the Ice Age.
events.quote: Many planeswalkers were trapped inside or locked out of the Shard during the Ice Age

events.summary: Portals are closed and Phyrexia is cut off from Dominaria, the Shard finishing its formation around 400 AR.
events.quote: effectively cutting Phyrexia off from Dominaria already in the earlier parts of the Dark Age

relations.quote: The only planes confirmed to be within the Shard were Dominaria , Azoria , and Ravidel 's unnamed home plane.
The Shard was formed as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast .
